reason: For a 50 USDC task I would just ask Claude for the draft and only pay a person if it came back bad. 55 USDC with only the top entries paid, plus USDC on Solana, is more hassle and money than a small task is worth to me.
objection: The 10% fee plus the reward is more than I would spend on a small task, and the AI-written draft is free. It is also a new, unaudited product, and I would be locking real money into it before anyone has done anything.
would_change_my_mind: A free first task where I put in no money of my own and the output clearly beats what Claude gives me, with a total cost well under 20 USDC.
